builds.name: followup-tracker
builds.what_it_does: Displays follow-up records from a database in a sortable table with action buttons. User reviews and marks items done/dismiss.

builds.name: article-pipeline
builds.what_it_does: Editorial Kanban board for tracking article stages. Same CRUD-table pattern as followup-tracker.

builds.name: workshop-certificates
builds.what_it_does: Generates print-ready workshop completion certificates. Add attendees, set workshop details, print/PDF. localStorage persistence. No backend.

builds.name: sponsor-desk
builds.what_it_does: Sponsorship deal tracker with sortable/searchable table of deals, values, expiry dates. Same CRUD-table pattern.

builds.name: kid-reads
builds.what_it_does: Kid-friendly reading log with emoji book covers, star ratings, reading streaks, celebration confetti. Parent PIN gate. Gamified activity tracker for children.

builds.name: commitment-desk
builds.what_it_does: Dashboard of open commitments from hermes.db. Same CRUD-table pattern.

builds.name: health-trend
builds.what_it_does: Health metric visualization — line charts for sleep duration, deep/REM/light sleep %, HRV trends, step counts. PIN-protected. Reads from static JSON data.

builds.name: speaker-prep
builds.what_it_does: Shows upcoming speaking engagements with live countdown timers. Expand each event to see and check off prep items (slides, travel, talking points). LocalStorage persistence. No backend.

builds.name: pair-picker
builds.what_it_does: Takes a list of attendee names and randomly assigns them to pairs, trios, or quads. Animated card reveal with confetti celebration. PIN-protected. No backend.

builds.name: letter-explorer
builds.what_it_does: Interactive alphabet explorer for kids — shows each letter with emoji picture associations, speaks letter sounds and word names via browser speech synthesis, tracks visited letters with progress bar and visual indicators. Warm gradient backgrounds, large touch targets, keyboard and tap navigation. localStorage persistence. No backend.

builds.name: workshop-timer
builds.what_it_does: Full-screen countdown timer designed for vibe coding workshops. Big projector-friendly display, preset durations (15-90 min), milestone visual alerts at 50%/25%/5min/1min, audio beep via Web Audio API, keyboard shortcuts (Space/R/F), +5 min quick extension. No backend, no data entry, no CRUD.

builds.name: ratio
builds.what_it_does: Aspect ratio calculator for content creators. Enter W×H dimensions, see reduced ratio, decimal, megapixels. Platform-specific presets (Instagram, YouTube, Twitter, LinkedIn, TikTok), standard ratios (16:9, 4:3, 21:9, 3:2), ratio lock, visual proportion preview, copy to clipboard. Pure client-side, no backend, no CRUD.

builds.name: decision-spinner
builds.what_it_does: Wheel of fortune decision maker. Enter comma-separated options, spin the animated conic-gradient wheel, and get a random selection with confetti celebration. Full-screen winner modal, adjustable options, minimum 2 required. Pure client-side, no backend, no CRUD, no dashboard.

builds.name: emoji-math
builds.what_it_does: Emoji math practice game for kids — visual arithmetic problems shown with emoji counts, four tappable answer choices, immediate correct/wrong feedback, streak tracking with confetti bursts at 3/5/7/10 streaks, result celebration screen with accuracy stats and best streaks. Pure client-side, no backend, no CRUD, no dashboard.

builds.name: workshop-spark
builds.what_it_does: Random app idea generator for vibe coding workshops. Displays one absurd, buildable app prompt at a time from 50 curated ideas. Fade transition between prompts, keyboard shortcuts (Space/N for next), dark projector-optimized theme, full-screen. Pure client-side, no backend, no CRUD, no dashboard.

builds.name: invoice-flow
builds.what_it_does: Printable invoice generator — enter client details, line items with quantity/rate, tax percentage, and notes. Live preview panel updates in real time. Print/PDF via browser print. Auto-incrementing invoice numbers. Pure client-side, no backend, no CRUD.

builds.name: meet-cost
builds.what_it_does: Real-time meeting cost calculator — enter hourly rate, attendees, and duration to see the total cost. Gradient severity indicator (frugal/standard/premium), comparison grid showing what else that money could buy, one-tap presets for common meeting types (standup, brainstorm, review, workshop, offsite), copy-to-clipboard summary. Pure client-side, no backend, no CRUD, no dashboard.

builds.name: text-stats
builds.what_it_does: Real-time writing analytics tool. Type or paste text, see word count, char count, sentences, paragraphs, estimated reading time (238 WPM), speaking time with adjustable WPM slider (100-200), longest word, average word length, Flesch Reading Ease readability score, and headline character counter with SEO length feedback bar. Pure client-side, no backend, no CRUD, no dashboard.

builds.name: breath-space
builds.what_it_does: Minimal guided breathing exercise tool — select a pattern (Box, 4-7-8, Tactical, Simple), watch an animated gradient circle expand and contract in sync with your breath, follow phase labels (Breathe In / Hold / Breathe Out), and track session time and breath count. Dark calm theme, no backend, no CRUD, no dashboard.

builds.name: bio-formats
builds.what_it_does: Speaker bio format generator. Enter your name, title, company, topics, social links, and achievements, then see 5 formatted bio versions (one-liner, social bio, 30-second intro, conference program bio, full speaker bio). Copy any with one click. Pure client-side, no backend, no CRUD.

builds.name: time-buddy
builds.what_it_does: Timezone coordination tool for media/journalist use. Live world clocks across 10 timezones (IST, ET, PT, BST, CET, SGT, CST, JST, GST, AEST) with business hour indicators. Interactive 24-hour grid to find overlapping business hours. Click any hour in IST row to see equivalent times across all zones. Pure client-side, no backend, no CRUD.

builds.name: name-tents
builds.what_it_does: Creates folded desk cards for panels, workshops, and roundtables with front-and-back layouts, pronunciation hints, short notes, and print-ready fold guides.

builds.name: stage-cards
builds.what_it_does: Generates a polished emcee card for panels, workshops, and talks with a host intro, pronunciation note, quiet cues, speaking-time estimate, copy actions, and a fullscreen stage view.

builds.name: run-sheet-nine
builds.what_it_does: Builds a minute-by-minute run sheet for workshops, panels, and live sessions with segment timing, cue lines, buffer pressure, and print/copy actions.

builds.name: backplan-studio
builds.what_it_does: Reverse-plans fixed-date work from the deadline backward, generating phased start dates, built-in safety days, weekend-aware scheduling, and a copyable execution checklist.

builds.name: scan-sheet-five
builds.what_it_does: Generates a single printable sheet of QR codes for live events so attendees can scan Wi-Fi, session, slides, and feedback links from one place.

builds.name: nudge-ladder
builds.what_it_does: Plans a weekend-aware follow-up ladder for unanswered business threads, choosing a cadence and turning it into dated nudge steps you can copy and use.

builds.name: pace-notes
builds.what_it_does: Turns a draft talk script into pace-matched rehearsal cards, adds visible pause markers, and provides a large stage mode for practice.

builds.name: rename-ready
builds.what_it_does: Cleans up messy filenames into a consistent batch with optional date stamps, prefixes, numbering, duplicate handling, and preserved file extensions.

builds.name: question-budget
builds.what_it_does: Turns a panel question list into a realistic moderator run, separating must-cover questions from reserve ones and budgeting answer time per panelist.

builds.name: breakout-brief
builds.what_it_does: Builds a clean breakout exercise card for workshops with a timebox, prompt steps, deliverable, facilitator tip, and regroup question that can be printed or projected.

builds.name: greenroom-card
builds.what_it_does: Creates a one-page speaker handoff card for live sessions, combining intro cues, tech dependencies, fallback steps, and room notes into a print-ready brief.

builds.name: transcript-tidy
builds.what_it_does: Cleans pasted call transcripts by stripping timestamps, reducing filler-heavy lines, normalizing speaker labels, and pulling likely action items into a copyable list.

builds.name: copy-compare-steel
builds.what_it_does: Compares two pasted text versions, highlighting sentence additions/removals, surfacing word-level changes, and summarizing count deltas in a clean browser-based review tool.

builds.name: gap-garden
builds.what_it_does: Maps a workday, subtracts transition buffers, and turns free calendar fragments into scored work windows with recommended task sizes.

builds.name: routine-ribbon
builds.what_it_does: Builds a visual routine ribbon for repeated home sequences, with editable step cards, countdown timers, live progress, and device-local persistence.

builds.name: subject-frame
builds.what_it_does: Lets you draft two subject-line variants with a shared preheader, preview how each lands in mobile, desktop, and notification inbox layouts, and copy the stronger version before sending.

builds.name: link-laundry
builds.what_it_does: Cleans pasted URLs by removing common tracking parameters, deduplicating results, and returning clean share-ready links with the removed parameters shown for review.
